controls.name: older-immutable-smoke-through-expect
controls.interpretation: The nonterminal prepared evidence is not an IMAP failure and does not distinguish an Expect lifecycle failure, child-process exit, or an externally bounded execution. The temporary directory was removed after the metadata capture.

observations: TCP, TLS, greeting, and post-TLS capability completed before LOGIN.
A successful instrumented run recorded LOGIN write and flush, an untagged response, a matching tagged OK response, then LIST, EXAMINE, and STATUS completion.
The private marker patch records only stage names, timing, response class, and tagged status. It excludes command bytes, response lines, credentials, account addresses, and message content.

conclusion: The successful independent control proves only that provider reachability, TLS, credentials, and read-only IMAP were healthy at its execution time. It does not exclude intermittent provider behavior at the failed smoke probe time. The smoke timeout root cause remains unresolved.

instrumentation: parent Expect records prompt seen, credential handoff attempted, EOF versus timeout, wait exit code, wait signal, and wrapper error code
child records password prompt entered and returned without recording password data
IMAP records LOGIN write, flush, response class, matching-tag status, and elapsed time without recording command bytes or response text
the smoke path records begin, end, or error plus elapsed time for the read-neutral IMAP probe and SMTP authentication/QUIT
the recovery path records begin, end, or error plus elapsed time for INBOX sync, exact remote search, Reader fetch, first fetched-body verification, Reader hydration, and cache/body verification
